name: realplus
description: Ask RealPlus New York real estate questions; Codex queries the Snowflake semantic view REALPLUS_BUSINESS and searches listing descriptions.

interface.shortDescription: RealPlus real estate data from Snowflake
interface.longDescription: Answers questions about New York listings, asking and closing prices, rents, closed deals, price cuts, agents, brokerages, customer portal activity, searches and listings near places (subway, courts, schools, parks, shops) by running read-only SQL over the Snowflake semantic view REALPLUS.GOLD.REALPLUS_BUSINESS. On first use a browser window opens: sign in with the Snowflake user you were given.
defaultPrompt: How many sales and rentals are on the market?
How many sales closed per month in 2025 and at what median price?
